Paramount Pictures and Hasbro have turned the Transformers action-figure line into a $5 billion big-screen franchise.

{s}The toy company Mattel has moved to turn its brands into full-fledged entertainment brands, including {LQ}Barbie,{RQ} the live-action adventure starring Margot Robbie that earned nearly $1.5 billion.
